styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent elegant feminine footwear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, near-black text and blocks #1C1C1C, warm greige secondary #D8CFC5, and rose-gold metallic accent #C9A86A; warm tone; modern elegant sans-serif headline copy in #1C1C1C only; consistent rounded rectangular and circular info labels; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 9 张详情页切片提炼。已剥离：鞋垫与内里品牌标、模特面部（全部为腿部裁切）、『100% PRODUCTS WILL DISPLAY』等源话术、『7天无理由退换』等不可验证的平台声明（服务承诺改由图内服务标签与副行直接呈现）。图文矛盾：源图卖点区称真皮而规格表为 PU 磨砂皮，模版不写死材质，统一以 {product} 参考图为准。主产品为女士一字带露趾细跟高跟凉鞋（金属几何饰踝带、约 8.5cm 细跟），与源夹名『鞋』相符（L2=女鞋）。定位与库内女鞋模版区分：非平底凉拖鞋、非粗跟鱼嘴高跟鞋，细跟一字带凉鞋为库内空缺型。
